correctness.rationale: On each sign half-line the map is affine with slope m on rational Markov cells; sign preservation and finite entry follow from exact edge identities. The all-m directed-graph proof yields an irreducible aperiodic Markov shift. Its exact stationary vector produces a positive piecewise-constant invariant density, a generating partition, mixing, uniqueness among absolutely continuous invariant probabilities and metric entropy log(m). Fraction computations confirm finite cases (13,078 assertions); no finite test substitutes for the all-parameter proof.

value.rationale: A complete, natural integer-expansion subfamily of the remainder-chaotified linear map has explicit sign-separated physical basins, exact finite Markov laws, entropy and unbiased-by-formula but demonstrably nonuniform stationary distributions. The nontrivial algebraic invariant cores and primitive graph across all integers address observable statistical structure absent from Lyapunov-only simulations, and the exact m=2 bias is directly informative for the model's statistical motivation.
